harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Created an SSH CA on node1 and configured sshd to present a host certificate signed by it. A client trusting only the CA public key (no pinned host key) connects successfully, verified both before and after a full node reboot.
actions_performed: Generated ed25519 CA keypair at /etc/ssh/ssh_ca(.pub) on node1
Signed the host's ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub as a host cert (ssh-keygen -s, -h, principals node1/NODE_IP/localhost, ~10yr validity) producing /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub
Set ownership/permissions and SELinux context (sshd_key_t via chcon) on the cert file
Added /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-host-cert.conf with HostCertificate directive, validated with sshd -t, restarted sshd
Verified with an ssh client using only an @cert-authority known_hosts line (no host key pinning) that the connection trusts the presented certificate

Captured baseline boot_id and health, triggered a self-scheduled systemctl reboot via nohup so the ack returned before disconnect, polled until reachable again, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified sshd health and CA-trust cert connection post-reboot

evidence.requirement: Host key signed by the CA into a certificate
evidence.summary: ssh-keygen -s signed ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub producing ssh_host_ed25519_key-cert.pub with correct principals

evidence.requirement: Cert file permissions/SELinux context and sshd configured + validated + restarted
evidence.summary: Ownership/context fixed, HostCertificate directive added, sshd -t passed, sshd restarted and active

evidence.requirement: Client connects trusting only the CA (no host key pinning)
evidence.summary: ssh client with only an @cert-authority known_hosts entry reports 'Host is known and matches the ED25519-CERT host certificate'

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline (boot id, sshd, cert files)
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 15443601-...  sshd active, cert/CA files present
Backgrounded systemctl reboot with delay so the exec call returned REBOOT_SCHEDULED before the node went down

evidence.requirement: Node actually went down and came back with changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Old boot_id observed, then connection timed out during reboot, then new boot_id 370c4c58-... with uptime 0 min confirms restart

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of sshd and cert-based trust
evidence.summary: sshd active, cert files intact, CA-only client verification succeeds again after reboot
